|lore=There are many different paths to becoming a Jedi, each with its own risks and consequences. A student must choose wisely.
|game_text=Once per game, deploy a Lift Tube from outside your deck. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Path Of Least Resistance or Run Luke, Run! OR Take [Set 0] Imperial Decree into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel opponent's Mos Eisley or Upper Plaza Corridor game text for remainder of turn.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Rite Of Passage (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[Rite Of Passage (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 21 July 2024<ref name="ht-63a0ee1">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual23-Dark/large/riteofpassage.gif</code> as published 21 July 2024: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/63a0ee1a7d7c0170dd5d75d69fefd6d973cd8f47/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual23-Dark/large/riteofpassage.gif holotable commit 63a0ee1] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Once per game, deploy a Lift Tube from outside your deck. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Path Of Least Resistance or Run Luke, Run! OR Take [Set 0] Imperial Decree into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel opponent's Mos Eisley or Upper Plaza Corridor game text for remainder of turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rite Of Passage (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata (Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf)<ref name="sheet23-20240802">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-23-Plus-Errata.pdf Virtual Set 23 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 9 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024). Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 2 August 2024: “Once per game, deploy a Lift Tube from outside your deck. [Immune to Sense.] OR Cancel Path Of Least Resistance or Run Luke, Run! OR Take [Set 0] Imperial Decree into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR Cancel opponent's Mos Eisley or Upper Plaza Corridor game text for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Rite Of Passage (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Rite Of Passage”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Rite Of Passage (V)]] (published 21 July 2024) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Rite Of Passage]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
